comp-bio.headline: Bioinformatics · Cancer Genomics
comp-bio.tagline: Bioinformatician with deep roots in cancer genomics — HLA typing & neoantigen discovery from real-patient NGS/RNA-Seq, reproducible Snakemake pipelines, 11 peer-reviewed research publications.
comp-bio.lead_paragraph: Engineered in-silico pipelines for HLA typing and neoantigen discovery from real-patient NGS and RNA-Seq data, packaged as reproducible Snakemake workflows, with wet-lab training at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT), Forschungszentrum Jülich (FZ Jülich), Kirchhoff Institute for Physics (KIP), and Seoul National University (SNU). A parallel line of experimental-biophysics research produced 11 peer-reviewed research publications — first- and shared-first author — in super-resolution microscopy of DNA-damage repair and chromatin.
comp-bio.second_paragraph: Equally at home in production: migrated 1,000+ analytical processes to Google Cloud, built reproducible data pipelines, and mentored 100+ specialists in Python, SQL & ML — while securing third-party funding and supervising 10+ students.

ds-ml.headline: Data Science · Machine Learning
ds-ml.tagline: Data scientist shipping production ML on GCP, grounded in bioinformatics and experimental biophysics with 11 peer-reviewed research publications.
ds-ml.lead_paragraph: Builds and ships machine-learning systems end to end, bringing the experimental rigor of a research decade across bioinformatics and experimental biophysics to every model and pipeline.
ds-ml.second_paragraph: In industry: architected the migration of 1,000+ analytical processes to Google Cloud, shipped BigQueryML models for anti-financial-crime & KYC, and coached 100+ specialists in Python, SQL & ML.
